newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN BUYS CZECH PACKAGE FIRM EMPACK. [CORRECTED 13:21 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN BUYS CZECH PACKAGE FIRM EMPACK. [CORRECTED 13:21 GMT]

text.p: The Swedish pulp and paper group AssiDoman AB said on Wednesday that it had purchased the Czech corregated packaging producer Empack.

In a statement, AssiDoman said the acquisition of the privately held Empack, based in the town of Olomouc (corrects from Zebrak), would complement its activity in the Czech Republic, where it holds a 39 percent stake in the largest Czech paper producer Sepap a.s. .
Financial terms of the transaction were not released.
Empack had a 1996 turnover of 18 million Swedish crowns, AssiDoman said, or about 69 million Czech crowns.
